title: Travel Agent
description:
Senior Luxury Leisure Travel Advisor (Sabre)

Company Overview

We are a well-established, client-focused travel company dedicated to creating exceptional luxury travel experiences for discerning travelers. Our team specializes in designing personalized vacations, cruises, and complex international itineraries while delivering white-glove service from the initial consultation through the completion of each trip. We are seeking an experienced Luxury Leisure Travel Advisor who can confidently manage high-end clients and deliver outstanding travel experiences.

Work Schedule

  • Full-Time
  • Remote
  • Schedule aligned with U.S. business hours

Role Overview

As a Senior Luxury Leisure Travel Advisor, you will work directly with clients to design and coordinate customized luxury vacations around the world. You will leverage your expertise in Sabre, luxury travel planning, and cruise products to create seamless, high-end travel experiences tailored to each client's preferences. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, client-facing environment and is passionate about delivering exceptional service.

Key Responsibilities

  • Consult with clients to understand their travel goals, preferences, and budget.
  • Design personalized luxury leisure itineraries, including flights, hotels, cruises, transfers, tours, activities, and travel insurance.
  • Book and manage reservations using Sabre and other travel industry tools.
  • Provide expert recommendations on destinations, accommodations, cruises, and unique travel experiences.
  • Coordinate every aspect of complex international itineraries while ensuring accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with travel suppliers, hotels, cruise lines, and destination partners.
  • Handle itinerary changes, travel disruptions, and client requests with professionalism and urgency.
  • Deliver exceptional customer service through phone, email, and virtual meetings.
  • Stay up to date on luxury travel trends, destinations, supplier offerings, and industry best practices.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience as a Luxury Leisure Travel Advisor or Travel Consultant.
  • Strong proficiency with Sabre (required).
  • Extensive experience planning luxury leisure vacations.
  • Solid knowledge of cruise products and cruise itinerary planning.
  • Experience creating complex international itineraries, including flights, hotels, cruises, tours, transfers, and activities.
  • Excellent knowledge of global destinations, particularly Europe, the Caribbean, the United States, and other popular leisure markets.
  • Outstanding verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Strong client relationship management and consultative sales skills.
  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while managing multiple client requests simultaneously.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and standard travel industry systems.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with luxury travel consortia such as Virtuoso, Signature Travel Network, or Ensemble.
  • Experience booking premium cruise lines and luxury hotel brands.
  • Additional language skills such as Spanish or Italian.
  • Previous experience managing a travel agency or luxury travel business.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote opportunity.
  • Competitive compensation.
  • Long-term opportunity with a growing company.
  • Collaborative and supportive team environment.
  • Opportunity to work with luxury travel clients and premium global travel products.

title: Head de Inteligência Comercial
description:
A Privalia vive um dos seus momentos mais relevantes: superamos R$ 1 bilhão em receita, lançamos novas verticais de negócio e seguimos evoluindo de outlet digital para plataforma de compras completa — com Retail Media, Travel, Digital Factory e muito mais.

No centro dessa transformação está a necessidade de uma inteligência comercial de verdade: dados que orientam decisão, pricing que maximiza margem, análises que antecipam o mercado e uma visão cross de 1P, 3P e Ads que nenhuma área isolada consegue ter. É exatamente esse o papel do(a) Head de Inteligência Comercial.

Mais do que analisar o passado, você vai construir a capacidade analítica que prepara a Privalia para o próximo movimento — conectando estratégia, dados e execução em uma área que atravessa toda a operação comercial.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Estruturar e liderar a área de Inteligência Comercial, definindo metodologias, processos, ferramentas e cadências que tornem a tomada de decisão mais rápida e precisa em toda a operação;
  • Desenvolver modelos de pricing e rentabilidade para 1P e 3P: entender a dinâmica de pricing (ferramentas, processos e procedimentos), margem de cada vertical e apoiar o time comercial com análises que gerem vantagem competitiva;
  • Construir e manter a inteligência de mercado da Privalia: benchmarking de concorrentes, tendências de categoria, comportamento do consumidor e movimentos estratégicos do setor transformando dados externos em insights acionáveis;
  • Ser o elo entre os dados e as decisões: colaborar diretamente com os times de 1P, 3P, Ads, Clearance, Marketing e Finanças para garantir que a visão analítica se traduza em ações comerciais concretas;
  • Liderar projetos de BI e analytics aplicados ao negócio comercial: dashboards executivos, modelos preditivos, análises de cohort, sellout e performance de marcas sempre com o olho no que realmente move o resultado;
  • Desenvolver e engajar o time: construir uma cultura analítica forte, contratar bem, desenvolver talentos e criar um ambiente onde dado e método são parte natural do dia a dia;
  • Participar ativamente das reuniões estratégicas como voz da inteligência: apresentar visões, questionar premissas e contribuir para as decisões mais relevantes da empresa com base em evidências.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Formação Superior Completa em: Engenharias, Administração, Economia, Estatística e áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável: MBA em Gestão Estratégica de Negócios / Varejo / E-commerce
  • Experiência sólida em inteligência comercial, pricing, analytics ou planejamento em ambientes de e-commerce, marketplace ou varejo digital, idealmente com visão integrada de mais de uma vertical.
  • Visão cross-funcional: entende como as alavancas de pricing, portfólio, sell-through e Retail Media se relacionam e consegue influenciar áreas sem autoridade formal.

Assistência Médica

title: Google Ads Specialist - Remote
description:

title: Global Sales Support Specialist (Contractor)
description:
Role Description

The Global Sales Support Specialist (GSS) is a critical driver of revenue within the Sales Finance organization, empowering the Field Sales Team with expert support in complex quoting, order processing, and product configuration. As a subject matter expert, the GSS ensures seamless deal execution while collaborating across functions to streamline processes and maximize efficiency.

This fast-paced role demands a proactive, highly organized individual who thrives under pressure. The GSS directly engages with internal sales and business operations teams to optimize sales execution, enable new product introductions, and keep quoting operations running smoothly and effectively.

  • Location - Sao Paulo - HYBRID/ 3 days in office or 70% in office throughout the month
  • Duration - 12 months

Your Impact

This position calls for someone who possesses good communication skills, sense of ownership, proactiveness and maturity working with confidential and sensitive information. This person is a self-starter, flexible, has a high level of integrity and quick to action in a fast-paced, team-oriented, collaborative environment.

Sales Support Excellence:

  • Support the Field Sales Team with quoting complex deals, responding to order inquiries, and providing guidance on product configurations in SFDC CPQ. Facilitate training on quote-to-order processes, including SFDC quoting sessions, ensuring that our Sales team members are equipped with the knowledge needed to drive sales success.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Work closely with teams including Deal Review, Pricing, Product, Sales Operations, and IT to ensure the smooth implementation of business policies, scalable quoting processes, and GTM offerings in SFDC CPQ.

Process Documentation & Best Practices:

  • Collaborate with the documentation team to ensure that our quoting decks are accurate, well-structured, and aligned to drive sales success. Act as a Subject Matter Expert in new product introductions, helping to design and refine quoting best practices for both new and existing products, ensuring clarity and consistency across all enablement materials.

System & Process Improvement:

  • Serve as a key partner in driving business requirements for system enhancements in SFDC CPQ, actively participating in the testing and UAT process to ensure new functionalities align with business needs. Identify and escalate system gaps or opportunities for process improvements, collaborating to streamline workflows and eliminate inefficiencies.

GTM Readiness & Operational Coordination:

  • Ensure the operational readiness of new GTM offers by collaborating with cross-functional teams to enable seamless execution of new product offerings. Build strong relationships with internal teams (Product, Sales, Legal, IT, etc.) to ensure alignment and smooth quoting processes.

Project Management & Communication:

  • Work with business partners to define objectives, set timelines, and track the status of quoting changes. Communicate milestones, dependencies, and project status updates to key stakeholders to ensure alignment and project success.

Prioritization & Execution:

  • Manage a shared mailbox for Global Sales Support activities, prioritizing requests based on revenue impact, customer relationship considerations, and timing requirements to meet deadlines.

Your Experience

Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in Sales Support, Sales Operations, Finance, or Contract Management, preferably in a SaaS or subscription-based business. Proven experience with Pricing/Quoting processes and an understanding of GTM strategies.

Technical Proficiency:

  • Strong experience with Salesforce (SFDC CPQ) and proficiency with Google Suite (Gmail, Sheets, Docs, etc.) is essential. A tech-savvy mindset and ability to navigate complex systems to enhance quoting processes.

Communication & Collaboration:

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with customers, internal teams, and International stakeholders. Ability to balance individual tasks while supporting team priorities in a dynamic environment.

Organizational & Analytical Skills:

  • Extremely detail-oriented with a high level of organization and the ability to manage multiple competing priorities simultaneously. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to analyze processes and suggest improvements.

Additional Requirements:

  • Ability to work extended hours as needed, particularly around month-end or quarter-end workloads. Flexibility to work alternate shifts to accommodate global requests and ensure timely support.
  • Language: Fluent English, Spanish and Portuguese.

Information about Palo Alto Networks

At Palo Alto Networks®, everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

We have the vision of a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. These aren’t easy goals to accomplish — but we’re not here for easy. We’re here for better. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

title: BIM Engineer- Mechanical
description:
About CTS Group

CTS Group is a fast-growing international design and build company specialising in data centre

development across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA). We combine engineering excellence, innovation, and digital transformation to deliver high-performance, sustainable, and future-ready data centre solutions.

With over 40 nationalities represented across our teams, CTS fosters a culture of innovation,

collaboration, and excellence — combining engineering expertise with manufacturing capability to deliver high-performance, sustainable data centre solutions at speed and scale.

With a proven track record and strong partnerships, CTS is a trusted leader in delivering large-scale, complex data centre facilities with speed, efficiency, and excellence.

Role Overview

The BIM Mechanical Engineer supports the development, coordination, and delivery of mechanical (HVAC, cooling, piping) BIM/Revit models for hyperscale and colocation data centre projects. Working within CTS's São Paulo engineering hub, the role bridges mechanical engineering knowledge with BIM modelling and coordination practice — ensuring mechanical models are accurate, clash-free, and aligned with project standards, client requirements, and applicable codes. The scope and level of ownership vary by experience band, from supporting model development under supervision (Junior), to owning mechanical model delivery end-to-end (Intermediate), to defining BIM strategy and holding technical sign-off authority for the mechanical discipline (Senior).

This is an opportunity to build specialist expertise in mechanical BIM coordination within a fast-track, multidisciplinary project environment, alongside experienced engineers across CTS's global project portfolio.

Responsibilities :

  • Develop and maintain coordinated mechanical BIM/Revit models covering HVAC, cooling, piping, ductwork, and associated plant systems from concept through IFC and as-built stages.
  • Produce mechanical drawings, schematics, equipment layouts, ductwork and pipe routing, schedules, quantities, and model-based deliverables.
  • Perform or support clash detection and multidisciplinary coordination using Navisworks and Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) or equivalent common data environments.
  • Coordinate mechanical model interfaces with electrical, structural, architectural, vendor, and OEM stakeholders to achieve accurate, constructible, clash-free outputs.
  • Develop and maintain model content in accordance with the BIM Execution Plan, level of detail/information requirements, naming conventions, ISO 19650 principles, and project quality standards.
  • Support the selection, sizing, layout, and BIM integration of mechanical equipment such as chillers, CRAHs, AHUs, pumps, CDUs, and heat-rejection systems, according to role capability.
  • Review or support the review of vendor and OEM technical submittals, equipment data, and model content for BIM integration.
  • Prepare model views, clash reports, bills of quantities, material take-offs, equipment schedules, RFIs, technical submittals, and other engineering documentation.
  • Participate in model audits, integrated design reviews, coordination meetings, technical workshops, site-query resolution, and commissioning activities.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of mechanical BIM standards, digital workflows, model quality, and team capability; guide colleagues where appropriate.

Você terá liberdade para conduzir oportunidades, testar abordagens em parceria com ao gestor, negociar com diferentes perfis de decisores e encontrar caminhos para acelerar o fechamento.

Requisitos:

title: Customer Experience Specialist
description:
Build the future of payments with AI, Pix & Open Finance

Type: Full-Time

Language: English

Location: São Paulo, Brazil (Hybrid)

Reports to: CPO/Product Manager

The Company

Nova is building a new generation payment network (i.e. reinventing Visa/Mastercard) using AI on top of Pix and Open Finance.

Its first product is a B2C digital wallet that functions as an infrastructure bridge between traditional credit cards and Pix, allowing consumers to use their existing credit card limits anywhere, even to pay Pix and Boletos in installments.

The company was founded by an elite team of fintech veterans and has had top-tier venture capital investors (Monashees, Canary, Canaan and Propel) since its inception.

We recently raised a large Series A and are now assembling a small team of exceptional experienced professionals to build, launch and grow its next generation of products.

The Role

We’re looking for a Customer Experience Specialist to own how Nova shows up for its customers, from the first support message to the public review that comes after it.

This role goes beyond basic ticket handling. Our first line of support is an AI agent, and a big part of your role is making it better every week: finding where it fails, feeding it the right answers, and stepping in yourself when a human is genuinely needed.

You'll own everything around it — our reputation on the App Store, Google Play and ReclameAqui, proactive outreach when a customer’s situation calls for it, and bringing what you hear back to Product and Marketing so we fix the root cause.

You’ll be the voice of the customer inside a small, fast-moving fintech team, with real ownership from day one.

This role is perfect for someone who:

  • Is genuinely obsessed with customer satisfaction
  • Uses AI to work better and faster, not just because it’s trendy
  • Wants to build a support operation, not just staff one

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop our AI support agent: continuously improve the AI agent that handles our first line of support — reviewing conversations, identifying gaps and failure cases, refining answers and knowledge base content, and raising the share of cases resolved without human help;
  • Handle escalations: personally respond to the cases where a human is required, with care, accuracy and speed;
  • Own our public reputation: monitor and respond across App Store, Google Play and ReclameAqui, and be accountable for our scores and response times on those channels;
  • Proactive outreach: reach out directly to customers in specific situations — failed payments, incidents, high-value or at-risk users — before they have to come to us;
  • Lead the Monthly Customer Support Meeting: prepare the data, surface the main pain points and trends, and drive follow-ups to completion;
  • Work side-by-side with Product Managers and Marketing: turn support signal into product fixes and clearer communication, and make sure customer-facing messaging matches what customers actually experience;
  • Keep things organized: support macros, help center content, processes and metrics — documented and up to date.

The Qualifications

Required:

  • Obsessed with customer satisfaction — you take it personally when someone has a bad experience;
  • Excellent Portuguese writing & communication skills — clear, warm and firm in the same message;
  • Great verbal communication — comfortable on the phone, on a call, and in front of the team. You'll be leading initiatives and reporting;
  • Comfortable with English (intermediate is enough — we work internally in English);
  • AI Native and Enthusiast: you already use AI tools to make your own work better and more efficient (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.), and you’re excited about shaping an AI agent rather than competing with it;
  • Organized and autonomous — you can own a process end to end without being chased;
  • Strong team player, curious and proactive.

Preferred:

  • Previous experience in customer support, customer success or customer experience — ideally in fintech, banking or a high-volume consumer app;
  • Familiarity with support tooling (Intercom, Zendesk or similar) and reputation channels (ReclameAqui, app store reviews);
  • Comfort with data: able to pull, read and present support metrics (volume, CSAT, first response time, resolution rate);
  • Experience dealing with sensitive topics — payments, charges, fraud, disputes;
  • Fast learner who thrives in dynamic, ambitious environments.

How You Work

  • Collaborative: open, communicative, team-oriented
  • Customer-obsessed: you listen closely and follow through
  • AI Native: you automate the repetitive so you can focus on what matters
  • Ambitious: eager to grow quickly and deliver impact
  • Owner mindset: you fix the root cause, not just the ticket

Other Requirements

  • Location: 3x per week (Tue, Wed, Thu) at our office in São Paulo
  • English mandatory

The Offer Package

  • Model: PJ
  • Compensation: aggressive salary
  • Stock Option: aggressive stock option grants
  • Other Benefits: premium health insurance, flexible hours, paid vacations and Wellhub

If you're excited about building the rails of the next generation payment network alongside a small team of high-caliber, highly motivated professionals, we'd love to hear from you.

description:
Pessoa Analista em Planejamento Financeiro

Sobre a CBO:

Somos a segunda maior empresa, em número de embarcações, do Brasil, no segmento offshore, com mais de 40 anos de tradição, inovação e pioneirismo.

Nossos principais valores são segurança, sustentabilidade, integridade, atendimento, resultado, inovação e gente. Temos como estratégia a contratação de pessoas com deficiência e outros públicos diversos, como mulheres, negros, e o público LGBTQIA+.

#fomoscriadosparadesbravar

Descrição da Resumida:

Responsável por executar as análises financeiras e o tratamento de informações que sustentam os processos de planejamento, precificação e avaliação econômica da unidade de Navegação, assegurando confiabilidade e tempestividade dos dados e produtos analíticos. Atua em suporte direto aos especialistas e ao coordenador, contribuindo para a operação dos modelos, a produção de relatórios gerenciais e o acompanhamento de indicadores de desempenho e de mercado.

Descrição Detalhada:

1. Apoiar a manutenção da base de dados financeiros e operacionais organizada, íntegra e disponível para as análises, extraindo informações dos sistemas corporativos e fontes internas, tratando e validando os dados e mantendo as bases atualizadas;

2. Auxiliar a elaboração de Modelos financeiros alimentados e atualizados conforme os ciclos definidos Inserindo premissas e dados de entrada, executando as rotinas de atualização e verificando a consistência dos resultados gerados;

3. Apoiar a elaboração de Relatórios gerenciais e materiais de acompanhamento produzidos no prazo, consolidando informações de resultado e desempenho, elaborando planilhas, gráficos e apresentações conforme os padrões definidos pela área;

4. Realizar Análises de apoio elaboradas para suporte às frentes técnicas, realizando levantamentos, cálculos, comparações e análises pontuais solicitadas pelos especialistas e pelo coordenador;

5. Atualizar Indicadores de desempenho e de mercado monitorados e reportados, acompanhando as métricas definidas, atualizando painéis de controle e sinalizando variações relevantes;

6. Gerar Informações setoriais e de concorrentes coletadas e sistematizadas, pesquisando fontes públicas, publicações setoriais e relatórios de mercado; organizando as informações em bases estruturadas de consulta;

7. Avaliar Inconsistências e divergências nos dados identificadas e reportadas, conferindo os resultados frente a fontes de referência, verificando reconciliações e comunicando divergências aos responsáveis técnicos

8. Cumprir e implementar as determinações estabelecidas pela companhia, na busca da melhoria da Qualidade, Segurança (Ocupacional e Operacional), Saúde e Proteção Ambiental, prevenção e combate à poluição e/ou eliminação das não conformidades, visando a excelência operacional.

Requisitos necessários:

Formação: Economia, Engenharia, Administração ou áreas correlatas;

title: Regional Sales Representative
description:
Position Details

Job Title: Regional Sales Representative —Curitiba, Paraná

Department: Sales — IoT/M2M Connectivity

Location: Paraná, Brazil — field-based and remote work, with frequent regional travel

Employment Type: Full-Time (CLT or PJ, to be defined based on candidate profile)

Reports To: Head of Sales LATAM

Role Context

We are expanding our commercial team in Brazil with dedicated territorial coverage by region. Paraná is part of the first front of this expansion, given the volume of strategic accounts already established in the area and the active presence of competitors (Virtueyes, Datatem, Allcom, among others).

What You'll Do

  • Prospect, develop, and close deals with medium and large companies in Paraná, focused on fleet management, asset tracking, and related IoT verticals.
  • Act as the local commercial point of contact, with recurring in-person presence at clients and prospects across Paraná.
  • Build and manage your own pipeline, from qualification through close, in coordination with the Head of Sales LATAM and the Inside Sales/SDR team.
  • Track and monitor local competitors (MVNOs and IoT connectivity providers operating in the region).
  • Present technical-commercial proposals, including products such as SIM DUO, vSIM, and eSIM, together with the Solutions team.
  • Negotiate contracts, commercial terms, and SLAs with corporate clients.
  • Report pipeline metrics, forecast, and results in a structured way.

Farm and Grow the Existing Base

title: Tech Lead
description:
A Tamborete é a plataforma de pagamentos padroeira dos pequenos e puxa saco dos gigantes. Gateway, checkout, API Pix e carteira digital para quem vende na internet: do infoprodutor que faturou o primeiro real ao e-commerce que já cansou de ser maltratado por adquirente grande.

Se você não nos conhece, passa no nosso Instagram (@tamborete.br). É, aquilo lá é a gente mesmo. E por trás daquilo tudo tem uma engenharia que precisa de alguém na frente. Esse alguém pode ser você.

A parte séria (porque essa vaga é a mais séria de todas)

Transparência de quem faz Reel rindo de si mesmo: a última pessoa que contratamos pra essa cadeira desistiu no primeiro dia. No. Primeiro. Dia. A gente nem tinha terminado de configurar o e-mail. Então já aviso: essa vaga não é pra qualquer um, e aparentemente nem o primeiro dia é.

Contamos isso porque diz tudo sobre a posição. Hoje não temos liderança técnica. As decisões de arquitetura acontecem, o sistema processa pagamento todos os dias, e estamos no meio de uma migração de monolito para microsserviços. O que falta é quem olhe para tudo isso e diga: vamos por aqui, por esses motivos, nessa ordem. E fique pra ver dar certo.

Você não vai herdar um processo de engenharia pronto. Vai construir um. Produto tem dono do o quê; você é dono do como. E sendo honestos como somos nos Reels: se você precisa de estrutura pronta pra liderar, a gente se admira de longe. Se montar a estrutura é exatamente a parte que te anima, continua lendo.

A stack que você vai liderar

  • Python e Go nos serviços, NestJS nas APIs, Next.js no front
  • AWS serverless: Lambda, API Gateway, filas e eventos
  • PostgreSQL no transacional, DynamoDB onde a escala pede
  • Observabilidade, CI/CD e segurança em construção. Construir isso é literalmente o trabalho

O que você vai fazer

  • Definir a arquitetura da migração monolito para microsserviços e a ordem de ataque, sem parar a operação
  • Estabelecer o processo de engenharia: code review de verdade, padrão de qualidade, critério de pronto
  • Montar observabilidade e resposta a incidente como hábito, não como pânico. Em pagamento, incidente sem processo é dinheiro parado na conta de alguém
  • Aplicar segurança de forma prática: dado sensível, credencial, superfície de ataque, tudo tratado como o que é
  • Liderar gente de níveis diferentes: desenvolver quem está começando, desafiar quem já é sênior, dar feedback difícil olhando no olho
  • Dizer não a prazo irreal com argumento, e dizer sim com plano
  • Trabalhar em par com produto: o quê vem de lá, o como é seu
  • Documentar decisão de arquitetura: registrada, não na cabeça

O que é obrigatório

  • Arquitetura distribuída na prática: você desenhou, colocou em produção e sustentou, não só estudou
  • Já ter vivido uma migração monolito para serviços e conseguir contar o que deu errado (se nada deu errado, você não estava lá)
  • AWS com propriedade, de preferência serverless: Lambda, filas, eventos e as dores que vêm junto
  • Observabilidade e resposta a incidente como hábito: você já acordou de madrugada por causa de sistema e melhorou o sistema pra não acordar de novo
  • Segurança aplicada no dia a dia, não terceirizada pro checklist
  • Liderança real de pessoas: aqui ela pesa TANTO quanto o técnico. Já liderou, já deu feedback difícil, já desenvolveu gente, já segurou pressão de prazo
  • Continuar com a mão no código: lead aqui não é cargo de reunião
  • Morar em BH ou SP e topar o modelo híbrido. Eliminatório: a vaga não é remota, e não adianta perguntar no DM

O que conta muito a favor

  • Fintech / meios de pagamento: checkout, liquidação, split, conciliação, chargeback
  • Ter trabalhado em PSP, gateway, subadquirente ou adquirente
  • Já ter sido a primeira liderança técnica de uma empresa (saber o que é construir o processo do zero)
  • Arquitetura orientada a eventos em escala
  • Infra como código
  • Vivência em early stage: decidir rápido com informação incompleta

Como a gente trabalha

  1. Mão na massa : liderança aqui também escreve código
  2. Proatividade real : sem processo mastigado, você cria o processo
  3. Autonomia de ponta a ponta : da decisão de arquitetura ao incidente
  4. Documentar e distribuir conhecimento
  5. Tolerância a ambiguidade : regra não escrita faz parte do jogo

Modelo, regime e benefícios

  • CLT, integral
  • Híbrido: 4 dias presenciais + 1 de home office (BH, Santa Lúcia, ou SP) · escala 5x2
  • Caju com VA de R$ 1.000/mês
  • Plano de saúde (não queremos que você passe mal, mas se passar, vai estar bem amparado)
  • Bônus real por implementações entregues com impacto positivo: arquitetou, entregou, funcionou, recebeu

Processo seletivo

  1. Triagem de currículo + análise técnica dos seus repositórios públicos (a gente olha mesmo)
  2. Entrevista com a Sol, nossa IA recrutadora
  3. Entrevista técnica profunda: arquitetura ao vivo sobre a nossa migração real + conversa de liderança com casos concretos
  4. Conversa final com o CEO
  5. Comparecer ao segundo dia de trabalho (etapa que passamos a valorizar muito recentemente)

description:
Sobre a Oft Vision

  • Acompanhar indicadores de Compras, como lead time, saving, cumprimento de prazo e desempenho de fornecedores;

Requisitos
  • Formação superior completa ou cursando em Administração, Engenharia, Logística, Comércio Exterior ou áreas correlatas ;
  • Experiência em Compras em ambiente industrial ;
  • Experiência com negociação e gestão de fornecedores;
  • Conhecimento de planejamento de materiais, abastecimento e gestão de estoques ;
  • Experiência ou conhecimento na interação com fornecedores internacionais;
  • Conhecimento do fluxo de importação e das principais etapas do desembaraço aduaneiro ;

Mais do que executar solicitações de compra, buscamos alguém capaz de entender por que, quanto e quando comprar .

Esperamos um profissional com visão do impacto das decisões de Compras sobre produção, estoque e fluxo financeiro , capaz de antecipar necessidades e contribuir para uma área cada vez mais planejada e estratégica.

Nas importações, esse profissional será o dono interno do acompanhamento da operação , trabalhando em conjunto com os parceiros especializados responsáveis pelo desembaraço aduaneiro.

title: ENGENHEIRO (A) MECÂNICO PL
description:
Pioneirismo que nos orgulha, responsabilidade que nos guia.

Muito além de uma divulgação de vaga, este é um convite para você fazer parte de uma história pioneira, que une inovação, responsabilidade socioambiental e relevância estratégica no cenário global da mineração de terras raras.

Somos a Mineração Serra Verde e operamos uma unidade integrada de mineração e processamento de terras raras em Minaçu-GO. Os elementos de terras raras (ETRs) de alto valor que a Serra Verde fornece são essenciais para a produção de ímãs permanentes usados nos setores de energia, transporte, aeroespacial e eletrônico.

Iniciamos a produção comercial na Fase I do nosso depósito Pela Ema, abrigando um dos maiores depósitos de argila iônica fora da Ásia, com vantagens competitivas e ambientais devido à natureza do depósito, com impactos ambientais relativamente baixos e situado em uma área de mineração consolidada, próxima à infraestrutura de energia renovável.

Na Serra Verde, nossos valores nos guiam todos os dias: Atuamos com integridade, confiança e transparência. Valorizamos a excelência. Criamos e compartilhamos valor sustentável. Somos otimistas e apaixonados. Assumimos a responsabilidade pessoal.

Valorizamos a diversidade de histórias, perspectivas e talentos, pois sabemos que é essa pluralidade que fortalece nossa cultura e nos impulsiona a alcançar resultados cada vez mais relevantes. Nesta perspectiva, todas as nossas vagas também estão abertas para PCD`s.

Propósito da função:

Como Engenheiro(a) Mecânico(a) Pleno(a), você será a referência técnica na manutenção da frota de equipamentos pesados da Serra Verde — garantindo disponibilidade, confiabilidade e custos sob controle por meio de estratégias de manutenção preventiva, preditiva e corretiva, da gestão de componentes e pneus e do domínio dos indicadores da frota.

O que você vai entregar:

Definir e executar a estratégia de manutenção da frota (preventiva, preditiva e corretiva) no padrão CAT e Volvo, incluindo pareceres e laudos técnicos.

Planejar e priorizar as intervenções, gerindo backlog, intervalos e o CAPEX de renovação.

Gerir o ciclo de vida dos componentes críticos, o estoque de peças e a estratégia de pneus OTR.

Elevar a disponibilidade física (DF) e a confiabilidade com monitoramento VIMS/CareTrack e análises de falha (RCA/FMEA).

Controlar o custo por hora (CPH) e os contratos com fabricantes e fornecedores, com relatórios técnicos e gerenciais de desempenho.

Assegurar a conformidade e a segurança dos equipamentos (NR-12 e NR-22), apoiando inspeções e auditorias e promovendo a cultura de segurança junto às equipes.

Frota sob gestão : motoniveladoras, pás carregadeiras, tratores de esteira e de pneus, escavadeiras hidráulicas, rolos compactadores, caminhões fora de estrada e geradores (CAT e Volvo).

Requisitos:

Formação

Graduação em Engenharia Mecânica com registro ativo no CREA.

Desejáveis: pós-graduação em Gestão de Manutenção, Confiabilidade ou Gestão de Ativos e treinamentos CAT/Volvo.

Vivência com sistemas de monitoramento VIMS (CAT) e CareTrack (Volvo).

title: Product Specialist - Remoto
description:
About HCLTech

HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.

Role:

As a Product Specialist, you will own product direction for assigned areas, translating customer, market, regulatory, stakeholder, and business needs into product vision, roadmap priorities, and actionable backlogs. You will lead discovery across key user workflows and balance customer value, business outcomes, technical feasibility, compliance, and product viability. You will also identify responsible opportunities for generative AI and emerging technologies. This individual contributor will apply strong knowledge of users, product data, business constraints, industry trends, and the competitive landscape. Success requires influencing teams, stakeholders, and executives through data, logic, and clear communication.

About You:

You are a curious, evidence-led product professional who identifies the right problems through user insight and strong product judgment. You use current AI tools, collaborate credibly with engineering and design, learn quickly, and take accountability for measurable outcomes—not simply feature delivery.

Key Responsibilities:

• Strategy and outcomes: Define the value proposition, outcome-based goals, success measures, and priorities; balance strategic opportunities with near-term and operational needs.

• Discovery and customer insight: Conduct interviews, usability sessions, and workflow observation; combine generative and evaluative discovery to identify actionable opportunities.

• Delivery and quality: Partner with engineering and design from problem framing through release; create clear product visions, PRDs, specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria; own overall product quality.

• AI and technology: Apply generative AI and prompt-engineering tools in daily product work; identify high-value AI opportunities and evaluate them pragmatically with engineering and senior product managers; monitor relevant technology shifts.

• Stakeholders and influence: Build effective relationships across engineering, design, data, and business teams; communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs early; present a clear product narrative.

Necessary Qualifications:

• Proven experience leading technically complex product initiatives from strategy through release, with measurable customer, operational, and business outcomes.

• Strong user discovery, interview, usability-testing, and problem-validation capabilities.

• Hands-on experience with AI-assisted workflows or emerging technologies, including governance, human review, quality controls, security, and responsible design.

• Experience working iteratively with engineering and design using an outcome-driven approach.

• Demonstrated cross-functional leadership and ability to align teams, overcome obstacles, and manage ambiguity, trade-offs, and risks.

• Strong analytical skills, including metric definition, measurement planning, and evidence-based prioritization.

• Ability to convert complex customer and business needs into well-documented requirements and practical solutions.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication, including simplifying technical concepts for varied audiences.

• Track record of delivering features aligned with requirements and requiring minimal post-release correction.

title: CLOSER - EXECUTIVO COMERCIAL B2B E B2C
description:
CRM, Kommo, Negociação, Vendas Consultivas e Inteligência Artificial

Trainning Education

Estamos procurando uma pessoa comercial com *forte capacidade de negociação, comunicação, organização e fechamento para atuar como Closer / Executivo Comercial, trabalhando oportunidades B2B e B2C .

Buscamos alguém capaz de assumir oportunidades qualificadas, entender profundamente a necessidade do cliente, conduzir a negociação, trabalhar objeções, realizar follow-ups e transformar oportunidades em *vendas e receita*.

Não buscamos apenas alguém que saiba apresentar preços e enviar propostas.

Queremos alguém que saiba conduzir uma negociação até uma decisão .

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

Você será responsável principalmente pelas etapas de diagnóstico, negociação e fechamento das oportunidades comerciais.

No dia a dia, você irá:

* Trabalhar oportunidades comerciais B2B e B2C;

* Receber e conduzir oportunidades qualificadas;

* Realizar reuniões comerciais;

* Fazer diagnóstico das necessidades do cliente;

* Entender objetivos, problemas, contexto, urgência e critérios de decisão;

* Identificar decisores em negociações B2B;

* Apresentar soluções adequadas ao cenário do cliente;

* Construir propostas comerciais;

* Apresentar propostas;

* Trabalhar objeções;

* Negociar valores e condições;

* Realizar follow-ups comerciais;

* Recuperar negociações paradas;

* Conduzir oportunidades pelo pipeline;

* Criar estratégias para avanço das negociações;

* Fazer fechamento;

* Registrar absolutamente todas as interações no CRM;

* Manter o Kommo organizado e atualizado;

* Criar e cumprir tarefas e próximos passos;

* Trabalhar oportunidades até que exista uma definição clara;

* Utilizar Inteligência Artificial e ferramentas digitais para melhorar produtividade, preparação e qualidade das negociações.

PERFIL QUE ESTAMOS BUSCANDO

Queremos alguém:

* Comercial;

* Comunicativo;

* Persuasivo;

* Organizado;

* Proativo;

* Persistente;

* Analítico;

* Bom negociador;

* Confortável falando ao telefone;

* Confortável conduzindo reuniões;

* Capaz de fazer boas perguntas;

* Capaz de ouvir antes de apresentar uma solução;

* Disciplinado com follow-up;

* Orientado a metas;

* Orientado a fechamento;

* Com senso de urgência;

* Com facilidade para aprender ferramentas;

* Que goste de tecnologia;

* Que entenda CRM como ferramenta essencial de gestão comercial;

* Que não deixe negociação sem próximo passo definido.

EXPERIÊNCIA COM VENDAS

Valorizamos profissionais com experiência em:

* Vendas consultivas;

* Inside Sales;

* Vendas B2B;

* Vendas B2C;

* Negociação;

* Fechamento;

* Venda de serviços;

* Venda de soluções;

* Educação;

* Tecnologia;

* Produtos ou serviços de maior valor agregado.

Experiência trabalhando com metas de *vendas e receita* será um diferencial importante.

CRM E KOMMO

Ter experiência com Kommo CRM será um grande diferencial.

Também valorizamos experiência com:

* HubSpot;

* Pipedrive;

* RD Station;

* Salesforce;

* LinkedIn Sales Navigator;

* Apollo;

* WhatsApp Business;

* Inteligência Artificial aplicada a vendas;

* Automação comercial.

Você não precisa conhecer todas essas ferramentas.

Mas precisa ser capaz de gerenciar seu pipeline com disciplina e utilizar tecnologia para vender melhor .

## INTELIGÊNCIA ARTIFICIAL NO PROCESSO COMERCIAL

Estamos construindo uma operação comercial cada vez mais orientada por CRM + IA + automação + dados .

Esperamos abertura para utilizar Inteligência Artificial em atividades como:

* Pesquisa de clientes e empresas;

* Preparação para reuniões;

* Análise de oportunidades;

* Personalização de argumentos comerciais;

* Preparação de propostas;

* Estruturação de follow-ups;

* Pesquisa sobre contas B2B;

* Preparação para objeções;

* Organização de informações comerciais;

* Aumento de produtividade.

Experiência prática utilizando IA no processo de vendas será considerada um diferencial.

O QUE ESPERAMOS NO DIA A DIA

Você precisa conseguir abrir seu pipeline e responder:

*Qual negociação está mais próxima de fechar?*

*Qual oportunidade precisa de contato hoje?*

*Quem recebeu proposta e ainda não deu retorno?*

*Qual objeção está impedindo o avanço dessa oportunidade?*

*Quem realmente decide essa compra?*

*Qual oportunidade está parada há tempo demais?*

*Qual é o próximo passo de cada negociação?*

*Quanto de receita tenho potencialmente no meu pipeline?*

Na nossa operação, *proposta enviada não significa trabalho concluído*.

A oportunidade precisa ser acompanhada até que exista uma decisão.

COMO MEDIMOS RESULTADO

Você terá metas e indicadores claros de:

* Reuniões realizadas;

* Oportunidades trabalhadas;

* Propostas enviadas;

* Follow-ups realizados;

* Avanço de pipeline;

* Tempo de negociação;

* Taxa de conversão;

* Ticket médio;

* Vendas realizadas;

* Receita gerada;

* Atingimento de meta;

* Aproveitamento das oportunidades recebidas.

Para essa posição, atividade importa, mas o resultado final é claro:

Negócios fechados e receita gerada.

O QUE NÃO FUNCIONA AQUI

Não buscamos alguém que:

* Apenas envie proposta e espere;

* Tenha medo de ligar para o cliente;

* Evite conversas difíceis sobre preço e decisão;

* Esqueça follow-ups;

* Deixe negociações paradas;

* Deixe o CRM desatualizado;

* Espere o gestor dizer diariamente quais oportunidades precisa trabalhar;

* Dê desconto como primeira estratégia de negociação;

* Considere "vou pensar" como encerramento da conversa;

* Não investigue o verdadeiro motivo de uma objeção;

* Culpe o lead antes de executar corretamente o processo comercial.

Queremos ownership sobre o pipeline e responsabilidade pelo resultado .

SOBRE A TRAINNING EDUCATION

A Trainning Education atua há mais de 20 anos na formação de profissionais e empresas em tecnologia.

Trabalhamos com soluções e treinamentos em áreas como:

* SAP;

* Inteligência Artificial;

* Cybersecurity;

* Microsoft;

* Cloud;

* Governança;

* Gestão de Projetos;

* Dados;

* Automação;

* Tecnologia.

Atendemos tanto profissionais que buscam desenvolver suas carreiras quanto empresas que precisam capacitar suas equipes .

Nossa operação comercial está evoluindo fortemente em:

CRM + Inteligência Artificial + automação + dados + vendas consultivas.

Queremos profissionais que queiram crescer junto com essa evolução.

Se você gosta de vendas, negociação, tecnologia, CRM e principalmente de *transformar boas oportunidades em negócios fechados*, queremos conhecer você!

title: Investment Banking Analyst - Client & Investor Relations
description:
Investment Banking Analyst – Client & Investor Relations

Location: Remote

Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM U.S. Central Time

Start Date: Immediate

Division: Investment Banking

Job Description

The Post Oak Group is seeking an Investment Banking Analyst – Client & Investor Relations to join our Investment Banking division.

This role is focused primarily on supporting the firm’s relationships with clients and investors throughout active transactions. The Analyst will work closely with senior bankers and deal teams to coordinate communications, manage follow-ups, prepare transaction updates, organize meetings, respond to information requests, and ensure clients and investors receive timely and professional support.

The role also includes financial analysis and modeling responsibilities in support of active transactions. The ideal candidate combines excellent communication and organizational skills with a strong understanding of investment banking, financial statements, valuation, and transaction execution.

Responsibilities

  • Support day-to-day relationships with the firm’s investment banking clients and investors
  • Coordinate client and investor communications, updates, follow-ups, and information requests
  • Assist senior bankers with managing client relationships and transaction-related communications
  • Help manage investor relationships throughout active transactions
  • Coordinate client and investor meetings, scheduling, materials, and follow-up items
  • Prepare professional emails, client updates, meeting summaries, and other transaction communications
  • Track investor activity, client deliverables, transaction progress, and outstanding action items
  • Maintain organized records across multiple active engagements and ensure timely follow-through
  • Assist clients and investors with administrative and transaction-related requests
  • Provide execution and administrative support to senior members of the Investment Banking division
  • Review company financial statements and other transaction materials
  • Build and review financial models, projections, and transaction analyses as needed
  • Assist with valuation and financial analysis
  • Prepare assumptions, projections, and sensitivity analyses
  • Review financial information and models for accuracy and consistency
  • Support other transaction execution activities as required

Requirements

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Professional and client-service-oriented communication style
  • Strong understanding of investment banking, transactions, and corporate finance
  • Highly organized and capable of managing multiple clients, investors, meetings, and deadlines simultaneously
  • Strong attention to detail and consistent follow-through
  • Ability to communicate professionally with business owners, executives, investors, and senior bankers
  • Strong financial analysis and financial modeling skills
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
  • Working knowledge of valuation methodologies and financial analysis
  • Ability to understand and clearly communicate financial information
  • Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, remote environment
  • Previous investment banking, private equity, corporate finance, transaction advisory, investor relations, or similar financial-services experience strongly preferred
  • Must be available to work Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM–6:00 PM U.S. Central Time
  • Must be available to start immediately

Why The Post Oak Group

The Post Oak Group delivers institutional-quality investment banking advisory with boutique-level service and direct senior involvement. We advise companies and business owners on complex financial transactions.

This position offers direct exposure to clients, investors, senior bankers, and active transactions while providing experience across both relationship management and investment banking execution

title: Regional Sales Representative
description:
Position Details

Job Title: Regional Sales Representative — Campinas, São Paulo

Department: Sales — IoT/M2M Connectivity

Location: Campinas, São Paulo, Brazil — field-based and remote work, with frequent regional travel

Employment Type: Full-Time (CLT or PJ, to be defined based on candidate profile)

Reports To: Head of Sales LATAM

Role Context

We are expanding our commercial team in Brazil with dedicated territorial coverage by region. São Paulo, anchored in Campinas, is part of this expansion, given the volume of strategic accounts already established in the area and the active presence of competitors (Virtueyes, Datatem, Allcom, among others).

What You'll Do

  • Prospect, develop, and close deals with medium and large companies in São Paulo, focused on fleet management, asset tracking, and related IoT verticals.
  • Act as the local commercial point of contact, with recurring in-person presence at clients and prospects across São Paulo.
  • Build and manage your own pipeline, from qualification through close, in coordination with the Head of Sales LATAM and the Inside Sales/SDR team.
  • Track and monitor local competitors (MVNOs and IoT connectivity providers operating in the region).
  • Present technical-commercial proposals, including products such as SIM DUO, vSIM, and eSIM, together with the Solutions team.
  • Negotiate contracts, commercial terms, and SLAs with corporate clients.
  • Report pipeline metrics, forecast, and results in a structured way.

What We Expect

Farm and Grow the Existing Base

  • Take ownership of and grow the accounts already established in São Paulo, increasing volume and revenue within the current portfolio.
  • Keep clients satisfied through constant visits and recurring in-person presence — not just remote contact.
  • Ensure fast response to client requests and demands, acting as their trusted local point of contact.
  • Anticipate churn risk and act proactively to retain and expand strategic accounts.

Grow — Bring In New Accounts

  • Prospect and close new accounts quickly, with a strong sense of urgency and focus on results.
  • Directly contribute to revenue growth in the region, not just maintenance of the current portfolio.
  • Establish Acceleronix's active presence in São Paulo — participation in events, trade shows, and visits that reinforce the brand locally.
  • Build a consistent pipeline of new business, without relying solely on leads handed over by the SDR team.

Requirements

Required

  • Based in Campinas, São Paulo, or willing to relocate to the region.
  • Proven track record in consultative B2B sales, preferably in telecom, connectivity, IoT/M2M, or technology.
  • Hybrid farmer/hunter profile — able to grow existing accounts while also generating and converting new pipeline.
  • Availability for frequent travel within the region.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, autonomy, and organization to manage a complex sales cycle.

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience at an MVNO, carrier, or IoT/M2M connectivity provider.
  • Familiarity with industry concepts: SIM DUO, vSIM, eSIM, national roaming, ICCID/IMSI/IMEI, LTE-M, NB-IoT.
  • Existing relationships with clients or partners in fleet management and vehicle tracking in São Paulo.
  • Intermediate/advanced English, for interaction with the Quectel group.

About Acceleronix

Acceleronix is Quectel's integrated IoT platform and connectivity company, built to help businesses launch and scale connected products faster. The company provides consulting, PCBA design, global SIM connectivity, and a secure device management platform, bringing hardware, connectivity, and software together into a single, end-to-end offering rather than requiring customers to stitch together separate vendors.

Operating as part of the Quectel ecosystem, Acceleronix is positioned as a trusted end-to-end IoT partner delivering scalable, reliable solutions from design through deployment, and appears alongside Quectel at major industry events such as MWC and the World IT Show to showcase joint IoT deployments across smart agriculture, smart home, and connected-device use cases.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary benchmarked to the local market
  • Sales commission / performance bonus tied to new business and account growth
  • Meal and grocery vouchers
  • Private health insurance with no co-pay, extendable to dependents
  • Dental coverage
  • Life insurance and accident cover
  • Paid time off plus statutory holidays, and paid parental leave per local law
  • Structured onboarding and ongoing product training, with internal mobility across a global organization

Learn More

Explore products, careers, and news at , or follow Quectel Wireless Solutions on LinkedIn.

Note: Responsibilities may evolve based on business priorities and market needs.

Acceleronix is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic.

title: Internal Audit & GRC Manager
description:
Webmotors is the leading digital platform in Brazil's automotive space, connecting millions of people to the best experience in buying, selling, and using vehicles . Here, you'll have the chance to accelerate and transform that experience through technology, innovation, and a team driven by the same purpose : making a real impact on the automotive life of Brazilians.

If you're someone who's restless, creative, and driven by purpose , this is the place to put your ideas into motion while keeping your eyes on what's ahead — always striving to be a little better every day. We value and empower every talent, offering a safe and inclusive environment where both professional and personal growth are top priorities.

We are CAR Group. We are Santander. We are Webmotors! And we're ready to drive this transformation with you.

Come join us and be part of something big!

#BeABigPartOfSomethingBig

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Internal Audit, Risk & Compliance Manager to lead a broad governance, risk, and control agenda across the entire Webmotors group. This role combines hands-on internal audit leadership with oversight of risk management, ESG coordination, data privacy governance, and information security follow-up — reporting into senior leadership and engaging regularly with executive committees.

Responsibilities

Internal Audit

  • Lead a team of internal audit analysts, covering financial, operational, technology, cybersecurity, privacy, and regulatory audits
  • Own and execute the annual audit plan
  • Ensure audit independence and objectivity throughout the review process

Risk Management & Internal Controls

  • Lead the internal controls testing agenda
  • Produce and monitor risk indicator reporting
  • Drive company-wide risk awareness initiatives
  • Own contingency planning for risk materialization scenarios
  • Track action plans for risk mitigation and audit remediation

ESG

  • Coordinate ESG indicators and action plan implementation across business areas
  • Facilitate cross-functional ESG committees

Governance, Privacy & Security

  • Manage whistleblower/reporting channels and related investigations
  • Coordinate risk and ESG committees
  • Oversee data privacy and protection governance

title: Sales Account Manager
description:
Do you have a proven track record in technical sales and account management? Have you planned and successfully executed sales and account management strategies within the energy and/or engineering industry? Are you self-driven and goal oriented, with a passion for technology, innovation and sustainability?

At DEIF, we are currently looking for a full-time Sales Account Manager to both maintain and generate new business opportunities, while developing long-lasting relationships with clients across Brazil and South America.

DEIF A/S is a worldwide leader in power efficiency, and we are on a journey to make a real difference in the world. We pursue an ambitious growth strategy and want to be a global trendsetter in power efficient products and solutions. We want to be the go-to partner for efficient power management, renowned for our intelligent platforms and smart solutions.

About the Job

As our new Sales Account Manager, you will be responsible for servicing our accounts as well as growing our existing portfolio. You will work directly with electrical engineering firms, electrical contractors, general contractors, integrators, dealers and end users/owners, and will utilize previous technical knowledge and experience to grow sales and improve specification rates, while driving general acceptance of DEIF’s solutions.

Additionally, you will collaborate closely with the local DEIF integrators and future distributors to develop a complementary business growth process.

Working tasks & responsibilities

  • Servicing and developing/growing new key accounts targeted by the company by introducing products, conducting demos/trials for approvals, and securing contracts/orders.
  • Aligning individual (quarterly and annual) goals and contributions with the department goals, as well as the overall sales/growth strategy.
  • Working with OEMs, integrators, panel builders, end users, and other relevant stakeholders—especially in the rental and critical power sectors—to ensure pull-through and that DEIF solutions are specified.
  • Building strong, long-lasting relationships with electrical consultants and including DEIF’s products in their projects’ tenders.
  • Responsible for price negotiations for product sales.
  • Actively selling to new and existing customers all ranges of DEIF products including making “cold calls”.
  • Participating in exhibitions and trade shows.
  • Following price management processes and entering relevant leads/visits in CRM.
  • Focusing on process improvements and team collaboration with the Operations, Service & Support teams.
  • Escalating relevant issues that would need immediate attention to the department manager.
  • Understanding safety measures in line with our Global Safety Policy. Identifying gaps and proactively suggest improvements.
  • Visit customers

What you’ll bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical or mechanical engineering.
  • 3 years’ progressive experience in technical sales/sales support with specific experience in distributed power generation, engine and generator technology, microgrids , alternative fuels, automatic transfer switches, automation or related field.
  • Experience with end-to-end sales cycle, from lead generation to deal closure.
  • A hunter mentality, with high resilience and proactive approach.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build solid, long-lasting relationships.
  • Knowledge of industry/market and customers.
  • Ability to travel as needed.
  • English language is mandatory; Spanish language skills will be considered a differential.
  • Knowledge of applications and products.
  • Excellent communication skills – Verbal, written and presentation skills.
  • Experience working with CRM systems.
  • Team player with growth mindset.
  • Knowledge of the marine segment and PLCs will be considered a differential.

At DEIF, we are Winning Together!

We promise you'll experience a culture based on values such as Ambitions, Perspective, and Respect, where we are Winning Together. We are a global company and work in many different locations – however, we are all united by a wish to make our customers and colleagues succeed. You'll experience a highly professional work environment where continuous learning, empowerment, and collaboration is essential.

We are in a continuous process of developing new intelligent products and solutions that can contribute to accelerating the green transition. Sustainability is central to our business, and we have recently been recognized in the EY Entrepreneur of The Year 2023, where we won the award in the ESG category.

description:
Quem estamos procurando:

Não queremos sênior. Nossa filosofia é formar, do zero ou do quase do zero, os melhores profissionais do mercado. Se você conhece alguém que já trabalhou com a gente você sabe do que estamos falando...

Procuramos gente jovem que vê na produção de vídeo um caminho para o futuro, já que hoje a criação de audiencia é uma das habilidades mais raras e valiosas que existem em todo o mercado.

Só que ser o melhor profissional do mercado não é para qualquer um. Aqui na Oros, nós escolhemos a dedo as pessoas que vão estar do nosso lado. Nós já conseguimos pegar 4 projetos do mundo digital quase que do zero e escalar para mais de 6 dígitos mês em menos de 3 meses.

E agora a nossa missão é fazer isso pela quinta vez!

Para tornar isso possível, o ritmo é forte. A gente vai te dar todo o suporte e vai garantir que você tenha todos os recursos pra você entregar o seu melhor, mas exigimos o melhor de você sempre, em grande quantidade, e às vezes vamos pedir coisas que você nunca fez.

Por isso a recompensa também é grande! Se você está buscando uma oportunidade de crescer rápido e aprender mais rápido ainda a Oros é o lugar certo para que você em pouquíssimo tempo já se torne um dos melhores do mercado.

O que você vai construir:

Nos primeiros 90 dias, o volume é alto e as prioridades são content e direct response. O objetivo é que, nesse período, a Oros já comece a ser vista como referência nas duas frentes. Aqui a gente trabalha com um "período de namoro" de 90 dias: se você bater as expectativas, sua primeira promoção e aumento vêm logo na sequência e a partir disso todo mês (com muito esforço) você pode ter uma nova oportunidade de crescer.

O caminho é seu para escolher: liderar o audiovisual inteiro da empresa, ou se especializar em direct response ou em content e virar referência/líder daquela vertical. Aqui o teto é muito mais alto do que o mercado oferece mas lembre-se que exigimos o seu melhor sempre!

Hoje a demanda de vídeo passa por edição de vídeo-aula, captação e edição de conteúdo orgânico de mais de um sócio, captação e edição em massa de anúncios, e captação e edição de VSLs. Se você já tem alguma experincia com isso ótimo, mas isso não é requisito para nada. Nós queremos o seu comprometimento e que voce aprenda rápido o resto é consequência.

O primeiro corte:

Se você não quer trabalhar presencial, do nosso lado, para aprender e ensinar, nem gaste seu tempo preenchendo para essa vaga.

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
Iquall es una compañía de software especializada en automatización y transformación de redes para operadores de telecomunicaciones. Trabajamos con grandes carriers, ayudándolos a modernizar su operación, automatizar procesos críticos y evolucionar la gestión de la red hacia modelos más eficientes y autónomos. Somos una empresa con fuerte ADN técnico, pero con visión comercial y foco en crecimiento sostenible. Nuestro modelo combina coherencia comercial, credibilidad técnica y ejecución sólida.

Buscamos un Technical Account Manager (TAM) con base en São Paulo, Brasil. El TAM es el dueño de la agenda táctica de sus cuentas: traduce la estrategia comercial en una agenda concreta con el cliente, construye y cierra la definición de oportunidades, y confecciona las propuestas técnico-comerciales. Es un rol con responsabilidad comercial directa —medida en pipeline generado, influencia presupuestaria y conversión de propuestas— apalancado en credibilidad técnica real. No es un rol de soporte, de delivery operativo ni de arquitectura.

Principales Responsabilidades:

Gestión Estratégica y Desarrollo de Negocio:

  • Comprender la estructura tecnológica, operativa y presupuestaria del cliente, y alinear las soluciones de la compañía, con sus iniciativas de transformación y eficiencia.
  • Detectar iniciativas y problemas estructurales antes de que se conviertan en procesos formales de licitación (RFPs)
  • Generar proactivamente oportunidades de upselling y cross-selling sobre la base instalada ("budget fishing").
  • Influir en la planificación futura y las líneas presupuestarias del cliente.
  • Definir y sostener la agenda con el cliente, en coherencia con la estrategia de cuenta acordada con el KAM.

Venta Consultiva (Soluciones Estándar):

  • Diseñar y presentar de forma autónoma propuestas técnico-comerciales cuando la solución se base en el portafolio existente.
  • Traducir capacidades complejas de producto en soluciones claras, viables y con sentido económico para el cliente.

Relacionamiento y Evangelización:

  • Construir vínculos sólidos y gestionar múltiples stakeholders dentro de organizaciones complejas, manteniendo credibilidad tanto frente a equipos de ingeniería/operativos como áreas ejecutivas (C-Level).
  • Orquestar workshops y sesiones ejecutivas ("Overview Demos") para mostrar el arte de lo posible e impulsar la adopción de nuevas funcionalidades.
  • Continuidad Post-Venta (Value Delivery):
  • Asegurar la correcta implementación y adopción de las soluciones vendidas.
  • Coordinar la transición hacia la ejecución junto a los Project Managers (PMs) y Delivery, identificando riesgos tempranos, pero sin gestionar la operación directamente.

Construcción y cierre de oportunidades

  • Generar oportunidades de upselling y cross-selling sobre la base instalada.
  • Crear, calificar y mantener actualizados los deals en CRM. El TAM es responsable de que el pipeline de sus cuentas sea real y confiable.
  • Confeccionar la propuesta técnico-comercial completa, orquestando internamente las partes comerciales y técnicas. Trabaja el pricing y la estrategia de cierre junto al KAM, que es quien aprueba y cierra.
  • Liderar las PoCs de cara al cliente, apoyándose en los equipos de Producto y CTO.
  • Traducir capacidades complejas de producto en soluciones claras, viables y con sentido económico para el cliente.
  • Construir las oportunidades sobre las campañas y el portfolio definidos.

Requisitos Excluyentes:

  • Experiencia: 5+ años en roles de gestión técnica de cuentas, consultoría técnica o ingeniería de ventas (Pre-Sales) con fuerte componente relacional y orientados a resultados comerciales.
  • Experiencia trabajando contra objetivos comerciales (quota, pipeline o revenue de cuenta), aunque sea compartida.
  • Industria: Experiencia sólida trabajando con operadores de telecomunicaciones (Tier-1 preferentemente), conocimiento de operaciones, arquitectura de red (fija, móvil, Cloud, ej. FTTH, 4G/5G), y plataformas OSS/BSS.
  • Formación: Título universitario en Ingeniería (Telecomunicaciones, Sistemas, Electrónica) o carrera técnica equivalente.
  • Idiomas: Dominio fluido de español e inglés.
  • CRM. Uso disciplinado de CRM como herramienta de gestión propia, no como carga administrativa.
  • Habilidades Técnicas: Conocimiento conceptual de software, modelos de despliegue (Cloud, SaaS, On-premise), APIs e integración. Familiaridad con los marcos de trabajo de la industria (ej. estándares TM Forum, eTOM, Open APIs). Entendimiento suficiente para influir técnicamente sin necesidad de ejecutar configuraciones profundas (hands-on).
  • Competencias: Comunicación técnica a nivel ejecutivo, capacidad para traducir problemas operativos en impacto de negocio, pensamiento estratégico a largo plazo y excelentes habilidades de negociación, confort en la conversación económica: pricing, business case, defensa de valor frente a compra.
  • Disponibilidad: Para viajar, dado que se trata de un rol global para todo el ecosistema de partners/integradores y resellers.

Deseable:

  • Experiencia previa y cartera de contactos en cuentas Tier-1, 2 y 3 de la región.
  • Experiencia previa trabajando en integradores y partners.
  • Formación de posgrado en gestión tecnológica o negocios.

Qué Ofrecemos:

  • Rol estratégico con impacto directo en el crecimiento de la compañía.
  • Trabajo con operadores de telecomunicaciones de primer nivel.
  • Participación en proyectos de automatización reales y de vanguardia.
  • Espacio para crecer profesionalmente combinando tecnología de alto nivel y negocio.

title: Product Designer
description:
Who We Are

We believe in a world where research never sleeps. 

Most companies struggle to understand their customers. Not because they don't try, but because market research can be siloed, slow, and incomplete.

Discuss is changing that. 

Our mission is to elevate human understanding at scale by building the always-on solution that transforms market research, making it continuous and intelligent while keeping humans at the center. We’ve built a comprehensive, innovative, set of AI-driven solutions that have made us only one of two companies named a Leader in the Forrester Wave Q1 2026 Experience Research Platforms Report. Discuss has earned top rankings by G2 for Best Results, Customer Relationships, Usability, and more for 14 consecutive quarters. We’re not slowing down any time soon. 

In the age of AI, scaling empathy without losing human understanding matters. Solving this problem makes what we do every day both interesting and rewarding. Our team believes in doing the right thing, even when it's inconvenient. We build tools that customers love because we listen to them. We believe in transparency and we own the results together. 

Discuss is a team of 200+ employees in 23 countries, serving 900 customers worldwide. We hire people who care about the humans on the other side of the data and want to help build something that hasn't existed before.

If you want your work to make the distance between organizations and the people they serve feel, for once, like it isn't there, we'd love to talk.

About this role

We're rebuilding how design happens at Discuss: an AI-assisted, code-native process where prototypes are real running code, feedback happens on live URLs instead of static frames, and a shared component system keeps design and engineering from drifting apart.

We're looking for an AI Forward Product Designer who's excited to work this way, someone comfortable moving fast with AI tools while keeping a high bar for craft, structure, and accessibility.

You'll own design work end to end across the pipeline: framing the problem, wireframing the flows, generating high-fidelity prototypes as code, running feedback on live previews, and closing the loop into our component library.

How this role works

  • You'll own solutions in your own area of the product, working closely with a product manager and engineers, and may float between teams as coverage is needed.
  • You'll collaborate weekly with the design director and the other design ICs for team alignment and growth.

What you'll do

  • Take features from problem to prototype. Help frame the problem and write lightweight specs, then move into wireframes and high-fidelity work.
  • Generate high-fidelity, interactive prototypes as real code (React, shadcn, Tailwind) using AI tools like Claude Code/Design, working against our shared design tokens and components.
  • Wireframe in low fidelity first, focusing on structure and flow before visual polish, covering every real state and not just the happy path.
  • Run feedback on live prototypes hosted on Vercel. Gather comments, triage them, and fold decisions back into the work and the spec.
  • Keep the design system honest. Contribute components and tokens back to our shared shadcn registry and its hosted component reference (Storybook), so what's designed matches what ships.
  • Work in the open, in version control. Your specs, flows, wireframes, and prototypes live as files in the repo, reviewed like code.
  • Design with light and dark mode and accessibility built in from the start, not bolted on.

What we're looking for

  • Around 4 years of product design experience.
  • Strong product design fundamentals: interaction design, layout, information hierarchy, and a good eye for visual craft.
  • Strong taste and design judgment. You can tell what's working and what isn't, edit toward the better version, and raise the quality bar without needing every decision spelled out.
  • Comfort with AI-assisted design tools and a willingness to work in a convention-driven way, where shared rules guide and review the work.
  • Enough technical fluency to work in code-based prototypes. You don't need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable reading and adjusting React and Tailwind, and working in a repo (Git, pull requests, markdown).
  • Experience with component-based design systems and design tokens.
  • Solid grasp of accessibility (WCAG basics, keyboard nav, contrast, semantics).
  • Clear communication with product and engineering. You can write a tight spec and explain a design decision.

Nice to have

  • Experience running or designing for usability tests.
  • Familiarity with Figma as a fine-tuning and handoff tool (we use it selectively, not as our source of truth).
  • Experience with Storybook, or documenting a design system for other teams to build against.
  • Exposure to MCP-based or other shared-system tooling across multiple products or teams.
  • Experience designing for B2B or B2B2C SaaS products.

How is success measured in this role

  • Speed from wireframe approved to stakeholder sign-off. You help shrink that gap.
  • Handoff fidelity. The work you promote into the component library holds up against production code without heavy rework.
  • Quality of feedback. Prototypes are real and clickable enough that stakeholders react precisely, early, and often.
  • Product outcomes. Work you ship moves adoption metrics (via Pendo) in the intended direction, and usability issues don't show up as a recurring theme in post-launch feedback or drive avoidable rework.

title: Business Central Consultant
description:
Business Central Implementation Consultant – Brazil & Mexico

15-Month Fixed-Term Contract | Brazil | Remote

Christy Media Solutions is recruiting a Business Central Implementation Consultant on behalf of our client to support the rollout of Microsoft Business Central across Brazil and Mexico.

This is an opportunity to join an established global Business Central programme, with the wider system structure and global chart of accounts already in place. Brazil will be the initial priority, followed by Mexico.

The role

You will work closely with the UK-based Business Central team, local finance and IT teams, other international stakeholders and an external implementation partner to ensure Business Central meets local business, compliance and Group reporting requirements.

Key responsibilities will include:

• Implementing Microsoft Business Central across Brazil and Mexico, including identifying local requirements and supporting a robust UAT process

• Supporting configuration, integrations, security and data integrity

• Identifying and addressing local statutory reporting, tax and e-invoicing requirements

• Supporting data migration and cutover activities

• Providing first-line technical support to users in Brazil, Mexico and the US (LA)

• Providing training and documentation to local users

• Developing reports, dashboards and analytics using Business Central and Power BI

• Supporting integrations with financial and non-financial systems, including local payroll systems and the Group project management system

• Maintaining master data and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and user experience

What we're looking for

You will need strong, demonstrable Microsoft Business Central implementation experience, with Brazilian implementation and localisation knowledge particularly important.

Relevant experience includes:

• Business Central implementation experience, with the client looking for at least a couple of years of meaningful hands-on experience

• Experience implementing Business Central in Brazil and/or Mexico, including statutory reporting, tax, e-invoicing or related localisation requirements

• Strong understanding of financial processes and accounting principles

• Proven Power BI experience

• Experience within international, multicurrency and intercompany environments

• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail

• Strong organisational and time-management skills

• Strong written and spoken English for communication with international stakeholders

An accounting background combined with strong Business Central implementation expertise would be particularly valuable.

The position will be approximately remote , although occasional visits to offices in São Paulo and potentially Mexico City may be required for training or face-to-face sessions.

This is a 15-month fixed-term contract , with an ideal start in late October/early November .

If you have genuine hands-on Business Central implementation experience and understand the complexities of delivering ERP solutions within the Brazilian market, we would be keen to hear from you.
